 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Complete horizontal mirror pairs of neighboring grid panels."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])

    # The full-length colored bars define the panel boundaries.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(g)
                if row and row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                if g[0][c] != 0 and all(g[r][c] == g[0][c] for r in range(h))]

    def chunks(length, separators):
        bounds = [-1] + separators + [length]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)
                if bounds[i] + 1 < bounds[i + 1]]

    row_panels = chunks(h, sep_rows)
    col_panels = chunks(w, sep_cols)

    for r0, r1 in row_panels:
        for p in range(0, len(col_panels) - 1, 2):
            c0, c1 = col_panels[p]
            d0, d1 = col_panels[p + 1]
            # Only mirror panels of matching width.
            if c1 - c0 != d1 - d0:
                continue
            left_has = any(g[r][c] != 0 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            right_has = any(g[r][c] != 0 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(d0, d1))
            if left_has == right_has:
                continue
            src0, dst0 = (c0, d0) if left_has else (d0, c0)
            width = c1 - c0
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for offset in range(width):
                    g[r][dst0 + offset] = g[r][src0 + width - 1 - offset]
    return g

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import json, sys
    print(json.dumps(transform(json.load(sys.stdin))))

{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u024/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4f45f309.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Complete a missing tile in a 2x2 arrangement by reflection."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])

    # Full-length solid lines partition the canvas into cells.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(g)
                if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                if g[0][c] != 0 and all(g[r][c] == g[0][c] for r in range(h))]

    def intervals(length, separators):
        bounds = [-1] + separators + [length]
        return [(bounds[k] + 1, bounds[k + 1])
                for k in range(len(bounds) - 1)
                if bounds[k] + 1 < bounds[k + 1]]

    rows = intervals(h, sep_rows)
    cols = intervals(w, sep_cols)

    # Find 2x2 cell blocks with three single-color motifs and one empty cell.
    for ri in range(len(rows) - 1):
        r0, r1 = rows[ri]
        r2, r3 = rows[ri + 1]
        if r1 - r0 != r3 - r2:
            continue
        ch = r1 - r0
        for ci in range(len(cols) - 1):
            c0, c1 = cols[ci]
            c2, c3 = cols[ci + 1]
            if c1 - c0 != c3 - c2:
                continue
            cw = c1 - c0
            cells = [(r0, c0), (r0, c2), (r2, c0), (r2, c2)]
            motifs = []
            for sr, sc in cells:
                vals = [g[y][x] for y in range(sr, sr + ch)
                        for x in range(sc, sc + cw) if g[y][x] != 0]
                color = vals[0] if vals and all(v == vals[0] for v in vals) else None
                motifs.append((color, bool(vals)))
            missing = [k for k, (_, occupied) in enumerate(motifs) if not occupied]
            occupied_colors = [color for color, occupied in motifs if occupied]
            if len(missing) != 1 or len(occupied_colors) != 3 or len(set(occupied_colors)) != 1:
                continue

            m = missing[0]
            mr, mc = divmod(m, 2)
            # Use a known cell in the same block; reflect along each axis on
            # which source and destination differ. The three present tiles
            # encode the same motif under these reflections.
            s = next(k for k, (_, occupied) in enumerate(motifs) if occupied)
            sr_i, sc_i = divmod(s, 2)
            src_r, src_c = cells[s]
            dst_r, dst_c = cells[m]
            color = occupied_colors[0]
            for dy in range(ch):
                for dx in range(cw):
                    sy = ch - 1 - dy if sr_i != mr else dy
                    sx = cw - 1 - dx if sc_i != mc else dx
                    value = g[src_r + sy][src_c + sx]
                    g[dst_r + dy][dst_c + dx] = value if value == color else 0
    return g

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import json, sys
    print(json.dumps(transform(json.load(sys.stdin))))
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
